title: Equal values can change order
notes: 9 7 7 3 5 1 is a max-heap already. In the first round of phase 2 the two 7s tie for the root, and the tie goes to the left one, the 7 that started in A[2]. It leaves the heap next and takes A[5], so the other 7 ends up in front of it. Heap sort is not stable.
